source: room Today in agents/rooms/rooms.json (jobs and capabilities), until Propose exists
note: These are the room's jobs, not ranked proposals. Propose will replace them with the top 10 built from findings.

cards.title: Rank the pipeline break by dollars every morning
cards.why: The break with the most money at stake is named first.

cards.title: Turn the break into 10 plain-English cards
cards.why: Each card says why now, the effect, the effort and the risk.

cards.title: Show orders net of returns and chargebacks
cards.why: Gross orders can look flat while kept orders fall.

cards.title: Alert the same day a number crosses a hard line
cards.why: A mid-day drop is caught before the end of the day.

cards.title: One queue of everything waiting on you
cards.why: Decisions stop sitting in 5 different places.

cards.title: Flag a test that overlaps a running test
cards.why: Two tests on the same shoppers spoil both reads.

cards.title: List the stages the system cannot read today
cards.why: A missing feed is shown, not assumed fine.

cards.title: Keep the US sale calendar and prep deadlines
cards.why: Black Friday prep is due before the traffic arrives.

cards.title: Check if an outside event explains a move
cards.why: A carrier delay or platform change can look like our fault.

cards.title: Approve or park a card by replying to a text
cards.why: You can decide from your phone without opening the page.
